text: Today, we have "narrow AI" that can only do specific tasks, like translating languages or recommending videos. But many researchers are working on "general AI," often called AGI. AGI would be able to understand, learn, and solve problems like a human. The benefits could be huge: better medical research, smarter education, and help with climate change. However, there are also serious risks, such as job losses, misuse by criminals, and losing control of the technology. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some say it is decades away, while others believe it could come within twenty years. Nobody knows for sure, so we must prepare carefully.
